name: Snowed In
source:
You (the player) barely made it to your friend Shiori’s house before the snowstorm reached its full intensity. Now the two of you are trapped inside, the weather canceling your original dinner plans. That doesn’t have to ruin the night, though. There’s plenty of fun to be had inside, and the two of you could even make your own meal. What could go wrong? (Uh~Oh!) 

[From the [url=https://shiorinovella.itch.io/shiorivisualnovella/]official release page[/url]]
